title: Annotated Code of Maryland, Public Utilities Article
source_id: Md. Code, Pub. Util. (esp. Title 4, Rates and Services; § 7-307 on termination of gas and electric service)
verified_how: Fetched the section page for Article - Public Utilities, § 7-307: live text opening "In this section, 'termination of service' means the termination, reduction, or refusal to reinstate gas or electric service...", requiring the Public Service Commission to adopt regulations limiting or prohibiting terminations during the heating season for customers unable to pay, and setting out the considerations (medical circumstances, assistance programmes, payment plans, customer notification). Served with enactments=false; no as-at date printed.
notes: The statute sets Commission jurisdiction, the just-and-reasonable rates standard (Title 4) and the disconnection-protection mandate; the operative billing, deposit, arrears and termination procedures are Public Service Commission regulations under COMAR Title 20 (regulation, not statute).
